_note: SIMULATED market maker, M4. Parties are fictional; units come from a simulated tap issue of each bond and cash from a funding account outside the simulation. Every value here is an assumption (see ASSUMPTIONS.md).

market_maker.name: Market maker (simulated)
market_maker.description: The bot's own account: inventory and cash it quotes from.

market.name: Simulated market (clients)
market.description: The other side of every client order in the simulation.

funding.name: Funding (outside the simulation)
funding.description: Where the simulation's starting cash comes from. May go negative, in cash only.

limits._note: Starting values, approved 30 Oct 2026. Copied into the database the first time only; after that the database is what counts (change a limit with scripts/mm.py, never here). Face amounts, currency amounts, currency per bp, hours.

defaults._note: bp of yield unless the name says price. All approved by Ethan on 30 Oct 2026.

simulation._note: SIMULATED market, M4 step 5, approved 30 Oct 2026 with Ethan's changes. Yield moves in bp; one step is one simulated minute. The jump probability comes from the profile (normal unless asked).

normal._note: About 8.1 bp daily yield s.d., close to real 30-year gilts.

stress._note: About 16.3 bp daily yield s.d.: five times the jumps, for showing adverse selection.
